important_evidence: ANIA uses CGR-based frequency matrix images of AMP sequences and a hybrid Inception-Transformer architecture to predict MICs for S. aureus, E. coli, and P. aeruginosa, outperforming ESKAPEE-Pred, AMPActiPred, and esAMPMIC. Web server and code available.

AI4AFP is an ensemble of seven models combining ProtBERT-BFD, PC6, Doc2Vec embeddings with RF, SVM, CNN, fine-tuned BERT, and a neural network meta-learner for antifungal peptide prediction. It includes a separate concentration-dependent hemolysis classifier. Web server available, but code not reported.

A collagen-derived AMP study used in silico physicochemical filtering to identify 7 α-helical peptides, three of which showed broad-spectrum activity with MICs comparable to LL-37 and melittin, but with low cytotoxicity.
A benchmark study compared VAE, WAE, RNN, and Language Model for AMP generation, finding auto-encoders performed best, and evaluated diversity, novelty, and property distribution similarity.
uncertainties: Should the specific generative models (VAE, WAE, RNN, LM) compared in the benchmark paper be recorded as individual models?
